task_title: File upload and chat box overlap when opened simultaneously.
task_description:
**Steps to Reproduce**

Navigate to https://dev.edubot.codework.ai/

Log in using valid credentials.

Once the home screen appears, switch to the Chat tab.


Expected Result

When the user clicks on “Upload File” or opens the chat box, each component should appear independently and clearly — without overlapping.
The user should be able to interact with both features smoothly without visual or functional conflicts.

Actual Result

When both the “Upload File” window and the chat box are open at the same time, the UI elements overlap. This overlap blocks parts of the interface, making it difficult or impossible to click buttons or interact with either feature correctly.

Environment  : Production

task_title: The backend fails to process PDF uploads and chat queries, resulting in a 500 error.
task_description:
**Steps to Reproduce:**

Navigate to the EduBot login page and log in with valid credentials.

Go to the chat tab and initiate a conversation.

Ask a question (even if irrelevant) and observe the response.

Upload another PDF file for further queries.

Ask a question after uploading the file, and notice that a 500 error is triggered.

Actual Result:
The system successfully handles irrelevant questions but throws a 500 error after uploading a new PDF and querying again.

Expected Result:
The system should handle the PDF upload and allow continued interaction in the chat without throwing a 500 error.

Environment : Production

Browser : Chrome (Version 141.0.7390.108)

task_title: PDF generation fails with a 504 Gateway Timeout error.
task_description: **Steps to Reproduce:** Navigate to https://dev.edubot.codework.ai/ Log in with valid credentials. Go to the Courses tab. Enter a course title (e.g., Cloud Security). Select an education level (e.g., Middle/High School). Click Generate Course PDF. **Actual Result:** PDF generation fails, and the Network tab shows a 504 Gateway Timeout response from the API: https://api.dev.edubot.codework.ai/api/courses/generate-complete **Expected Result:** The PDF should be generated successfully, and the response should return the generated file for download without timeout errors. **Impact:** Users are unable to generate course PDFs due to backend timeout issues. **Priority:** High (functionality blocker)

task_title: Delete Course button unresponsive and loading issue after deletion.
task_description:
**Steps to Reproduce:**

Navigate to https://dev.edubot.codework.ai/

Log in with valid credentials.

Go to the Learning tab.

Attempt to delete a course.

**Actual Result:**

The Delete Course button is not responsive for users.

When clicking the delete button, the confirmation box remains visible and does not clearly indicate whether the course was deleted.

After deletion, both the “Course deleted successfully” message and the loading screen appear simultaneously, causing confusion.

Overall, there is a loading and responsiveness issue during course deletion.

Expected Result:

The delete confirmation box should close immediately after the user confirms deletion.

A clear success message should appear once the course is deleted.

The loading indicator should display properly without overlapping messages, providing a smooth user experience.

Priority: Medium

Impact: Causes user confusion and poor UX during course deletion, as the action feedback is unclear and loading overlaps with success message.

task_title: Plagiarism Detection and AI Content Detection modules are not analyzing content properly.
task_description: **Steps to Reproduce:** Navigate to https://dev.edubot.codework.ai/ Log in with valid credentials. Go to the Analysis tab. Navigate to the Plagiarism Detection or AI Content Detection section. Enter or upload any valid text/content. Click on the Analyze or Detect button. Observe the output. Expected Result: Both Plagiarism Detection and AI Content Detection features should properly analyze the given content and display accurate detection results (e.g., originality score, matched sources, or AI-generated percentage). Actual Result: Both Plagiarism Detection and AI Content Detection modules fail to detect or analyze the content properly — no proper analysis or results are displayed even after initiating the detection process. Priority: High Impact: This issue impacts core functionality as users are unable to analyze or validate content through two major detection tools. It affects user trust and overall product reliability.
